put.description:
Switch between demo and real. Refused while a chain or trade is running; real also needs
QUOTEX_ALLOW_REAL=true (decision D-15).

get.description:
Newest first. The database trails the engine by a moment; the WebSocket snapshot is the
live picture of what is running right now.

post.description:
End the chain at once, so the group is free for new signals (the dashboard's "skip to
base"). An open trade still settles and is recorded, but nothing follows it.

Let the open trade settle, then end the chain without a further step. Repeating it is
harmless.

delete.description: Only a group with no history can be deleted; otherwise disable it.

put.description: Chains already running keep the settings they started with.

post.description: New signals of the group are ignored (and say so); its running chains finish.

put.description: Works with or without the engine running, so limits can be set before it is enabled.

post.description: No order goes out from now on, follow-ups included. Repeating it is harmless.

get.description: Every order a limit blocked and every other safety event, newest first.

put.description:
Set the global limits. Works with or without the engine running, so they can be set before
it is ever enabled. Today's result is kept: this is no way to reset a stop-loss.

get.description: Every message the groups sent, newest first, with what became of it and why.
The whole picture of the system now: the same data the WebSocket sends first.
